content: The results in terms of EM and F1 is summarized in Table TABREF20 . We observe that Joint SAN outperforms the SAN baseline with a large margin, e.g., 67.89 vs 69.27 (+1.38) and 70.68 vs 72.20 (+1.52) in terms of EM and F1 scores respectively, so it demonstrates the effectiveness of the joint optimization. By incorporating the output information of classifier into Joint SAN, it obtains a slight improvement, e.g., 72.2 vs 72.66 (+0.46) in terms of F1 score. By analyzing the results, we found that in most cases when our model extract an NULL string answer, the classifier also predicts it as an unanswerable question with a high probability.
